1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 d6 3.Nc3 e5 4.e3 Nbd7 5.Bd.strategy: Develops the bishop on its active diagonal, where it supports a later e4 advance. White accepts a slow, solid build-up in which Black can complete development safely, and the fight for the centre is put off.
1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 d6 3.Nc3 e5 4.e3 Nbd7 5.Bd.name: Old Indian Defence: Duz-Khotimirsky Variation
